'When this attacks, **opt 1**.'

SHAPE: an Action - Attack card's when-this-attacks ability is TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK (blackout_kick_red precedent; per DSL_REFERENCE an Action - Attack is never ATTACK_REACTION - that ability type would never fire). Release note ('triggers when it resolves on the stack and becomes an attacking card') = ON_ATTACK, which fires as the card enters the combat chain - that exact moment.

OPT handler verified: effect_types.py:1288 reads 'amount' (default 1) and calls effect_opt (the CR opt primitive), so {"type": "OPT", "amount": 1} is the corpus spelling (clarity_potion_blue et al).

NOT A DOUBLE-AUTHOR of the DB keyword (checked, not assumed): slug_index carries keywords ["Opt"] with no number, and build_keyword_triggers maps a bare 'opt' to an 'on_play' trigger (triggers/triggers.py:352-357). But attack action cards are not public at game start, so their keyword triggers register only when the card enters combat (engine.py:550) - AFTER the engine 'on_play' event has already fired at play time (play.py:1211). The keyword path is dead for this card as the engine stands; the DSL trigger authored here is the only live opt, and it fires at the release-note timing. If the keyword-registration order is ever fixed, this card would double-opt and one of the two paths should then be removed.
